title: Philly Cheesesteaks
steps:
Cook onion, pepper
+ mushrooms 6-8 min.
Set aside

Sear the steak 2-3 min,
chop as it browns

Veggies back, provolone on,
cover 1 min.
Into toasted rolls
vo: Philly cheesesteaks at home, in thirty minutes.
You need shaved steak, hoagie rolls, provolone, an onion, a green pepper and mushrooms.
Cook the onion, pepper and mushrooms until soft, then set them aside.
Sear the steak two to three minutes, chopping it up as it browns.
Add the veggies back, top with provolone, cover a minute to melt, and pile it into toasted rolls.
